metaTitle: {brand} — game keys, subscriptions and gift cards
metaDescription: Game and DLC keys, subscriptions, gift cards and top-ups from {brand}. Platform, activation region and languages on every product; keys are issued to your account after payment is confirmed.

door.title: Game keys, kept under lock until they're yours.
door.leadCatalogue: Games, DLC, gift cards and subscriptions for Steam, Epic, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo and more.
door.leadPayment: Pay on a hosted card page with 3-D Secure;
door.leadDelivery: your key is delivered to your account, usually within minutes after payment is confirmed.
door.platformsLabel: Platforms with the most keys in stock

strip.label: How payment and delivery are handled
strip.hosted: Card details go on a hosted payment page
strip.guarantee: Replacement or refund if a key doesn't work

vault.title: Pick your platform
vault.lead: Each locker shows how many keys are in stock for that platform and today's lowest price.

deals.title: Price cuts
deals.lead: Keys priced below their recent price. The earlier price shown is the lowest price in the {days} days before the cut.
deals.railLabel: Keys with the largest price cuts

theater.title: Watch a key leave the vault
theater.lead: Five short demos of the store, played with sample data: choosing a key, paying on the hosted page, revealing the key, redeeming it, and getting help if it doesn't work.

genres.title: Browse by genre
genres.lead: Every genre with keys in stock, counted from the catalogue.

releases.title: New releases
releases.lead: Released in the last eight weeks and in stock now.
releases.rulerLabel: {count} titles released in the last {weeks} weeks

prepaid.giftLead: Store credit for the platform you play on. Check the card's region before you buy.
prepaid.subsLead: Membership codes by service and length. Prices are per code; the region column says which accounts it works on.
prepaid.subsCaption: Subscription prices by service and duration

activation.title: How activation works
activation.lead: Every key activates on the platform named on its page. Pick yours to see the steps.
activation.stillLabel: Illustration of redeeming a key on {name}, with sample data

ledger.title: What's in the vault, and what never is
ledger.lead: Where each part of an order is kept, who can see it, and what happens when something goes wrong.
ledger.keptKeys: Your keys. Stored encrypted (AES-256) and decrypted only when you choose Reveal in your account.
ledger.keptKeysPlain: Your keys. Kept in your account and shown only when you choose Reveal.
ledger.keptOrders: Your orders and PDF invoices, for as long as the law requires ({years} years).
ledger.neverCard: Your card number, expiry date and security code. You type them on the payment provider's hosted page, not on Keyrook.
ledger.neverBank: Your bank's 3-D Secure confirmation happens between you and your bank.
ledger.wrongKey: A key that doesn't work is replaced, or refunded if no replacement is available.
ledger.wrongPayment: If a payment fails, you aren't charged.
ledger.legend: Card details (outlined squares) stop at the payment provider. Keyrook receives only the confirmation (filled squares).
ledger.stillCaption: The 3-D Secure step, shown with sample data
ledger.receivesHosted: Your card number, expiry date and security code, typed on the provider's page.
ledger.receivesBank: Your approval of the payment, in your banking app or by code.
ledger.receivesKeyrook: Payment confirmed, the amount and your order number. Never the card number.
ledger.receivesAccount: Your key, stored encrypted and decrypted only when you choose Reveal.
ledger.receivesAccountPlain: Your key, shown when you choose Reveal.

budget.title: Set a budget
budget.lead: Turn the dial to a price band. Bands are in your currency.
budget.unavailable: Fewer than {min} keys in this band right now

open.title: The door's open.
open.line: Search the catalogue, or start with your platform.
